intro: Look-alike kanji usually share the part that gives the sound and differ in the part that gives the meaning (the radical). 復, 複 and 腹 are all ふく; 験, 検 and 険 are all けん. So the reading cannot help you: the meaning of the word must point to the radical. Ask what the word is about, find the radical that matches, and only then check the small strokes and the okurigana.

skills.rule: Ask, in order: what does the word mean here, which radical carries that meaning, and are the strokes and okurigana right?
skills.explain:
Step 1: is the sound shared by two different words (あう, あつい, はやい, かえる)? Then meaning alone decides: 会う a person, 合う a fit.

Step 2: ignore the shared part and look at the radical. 扌 hand: 持つ hold. 彳 going: 待つ wait, 往復 return trip. 牛 cow: 特別. 亻 person: 住む live. 氵 water: 注ぐ pour, 注意. 月 body: お腹. 衤 clothing, layers: 複数. 馬 horse: 試験. 木 wood: 検査. 阝 hill: 危険. 糸 thread: 成績. 禾 grain: 面積. 金 metal: 記録.

Step 3: some pairs differ only in a stroke. 末 end has the longer top line; 未 not yet has the shorter one. 牛 cow pokes through the top; 午 noon does not. 休 rest is a person by a tree (木); 体 body has 本. 鳥 bird has legs; 島 island has a mountain (山) instead.

Step 4: check the okurigana and read the word back.
patterns: 1. Same sound, two words? → meaning decides
2. Shared sound part? → match the radical to the meaning
3. One-stroke pair? → 末/未, 牛/午, 休/体, 鳥/島

examples.jp: 駅[えき]で友達[ともだち]を{待[ま]って}います。
examples.en: I'm waiting for a friend at the station.

examples.jp: 重[おも]い荷物[にもつ]を{持[も]って}います。
この町[まち]に{住[す]んで}十年[じゅうねん]になります。
examples.en: I have lived in this town for ten years.

examples.jp: 道[みち]を渡[わた]るときは車[くるま]に{注意[ちゅうい]}してください。
examples.en: Please watch out for cars when you cross the road.

examples.jp: 来週[らいしゅう]、日本語[にほんご]の{試験[しけん]}があります。
examples.en: I have a Japanese exam next week.

examples.jp: このプールは深[ふか]くて{危険[きけん]}です。
examples.en: This pool is deep and dangerous.

contrast.note: Same right side 寺. Holding uses the hand 扌 (持つ), waiting uses going 彳 (待つ), special uses the cow 牛 (特別).
All けん. A test is 試験 or 経験 (horse 馬), an inspection is 検査 (wood 木), danger is 危険 (hill 阝).
All ふく. Going back is 往復 or 復習 (彳), several layers is 複数 or 複雑 (衤), the belly is お腹 (月).

mistakes.bad: 駅[えき]で一時間[いちじかん]{持[ま]ちました}。
mistakes.good: 駅[えき]で一時間[いちじかん]{待[ま]ちました}。
mistakes.note: Waiting is going-related: 彳, not the hand.

mistakes.bad: 毎日[まいにち]{複習[ふくしゅう]}をしています。
mistakes.good: 毎日[まいにち]{復習[ふくしゅう]}をしています。
mistakes.note: Review is going back over a lesson: 復, with the going radical.

mistakes.bad: 会議[かいぎ]はまだ{末定[みてい]}です。
mistakes.good: 会議[かいぎ]はまだ{未定[みてい]}です。
mistakes.note: Not yet decided is 未, with the shorter top line; 末 means end.

skills.tip: Ignore the part you hear and look at the part you mean: hand, going, water, person, body, thread, grain.
